messages:
zoe_csm: Quick alert — ingestion backlog observed 08:15 PST affecting ~30 tenants; 6 are high-touch with renewals in 21-45 days. Need customer comms + mitigation plan.

maria_cs: Thanks Zoe. Can we keep messaging short and offer prioritized re-runs + a credit? Also want a one-question feedback after re-run.

ash_support: Created tickets CS-8422..CS-8451. Support will only re-run if customer provides upload_id to avoid duplicates. Calendar slots prepped for priority re-runs.

devon_eng: Root cause: transient object-store 5xx spiking, our continuous-batcher retried aggressively and saturated workers. We applied an emergency cap at 09:00; throughput recovered by 09:25. Full fix (backoff + idempotency) ETA ~24h.

sre_oncall: Logging timeline to incident tracker and will announce when patch is in canary.

maria_cs: Drafting two templates — high-touch and trial. High-touch: Hi <Name> — were sorry: your upload was delayed this morning. Weve mitigated the issue and can prioritize a free re-run this week to avoid renewal impact. Reply with upload_id or pick a slot. Well follow with a short RCA within 48h and a 1-question survey link.

maria_cs: Trial template: Hi — brief delay earlier today; issue mitigated. Reply to request a re-run; affected trials receive a 1-month credit.

ash_support: Add: include original upload timestamp in requests so we can dedupe. Runbook updated and tag onboard-ingest-2026-03.

zoe_csm: Action items: 1) Maria send high-touch now, 2) queue trial automation, 3) Support do re-runs on demand with upload_id, 4) Eng post RCA draft within 48h, 5) Offer 1-month credit to trials / prioritized activation for high-touch.

alan_support_bot: Support tickets linked and outbound queued.

zoe_csm: Sending high-touch outbound and tagging AEs. Will update thread with replies and any renewal risk escalations. :pray:
